scripts.text:
[Mark]
Unlike the other doors we saw this door has traces of it being blocked from this side.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
這扇門跟之前見過的不同，像是被人從這一側堵住了。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
It's dangerous here.
It would be better to come back next time when we are stronger.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
這裡很危險，等我們更強些再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Is there something inside?
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
裡面有什麼東西嗎？

scripts.text:
...It doesn't feel right here.
It may be dangerous alone so it might be better to form a party.
scripts.translation:
...這裡感覺不對勁。
一個人去可能很危險，最好組個隊伍。

scripts.text: Go in.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Open door.
scripts.translation: 開啟門

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I'm opening the door.
Go in when the door is completely open.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
我要開門了。
等門完全開啟後再進去。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
...feel very suspicious!
It's a little dangerous to be alone. It is recommended to team up!
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
...這裡很可疑！
一個人太危險，還是組隊吧！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
The door does not seem to be fully open.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
門似乎沒有完全開啟。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Hey... what is going on?
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
嘿...這是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Mark]
...You look tired.
Since you went there you should take a day to rest.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
...你看起來很累，去過那裡後，最好休息一天。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I can't believe you want to enter a place like this again...
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
真不敢相信你想再次進入這種地方...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Verity, are you alright?
You do not look good...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
薇麗蒂，你沒事吧？
你看起來氣色不好...

scripts.text:
[Du]
I have a bad feeling about this...
scripts.translation:
[杜]
我對這裡有種不好的預感...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Umph...I suddenly have a feeling that's not good.
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
唔...突然有種不好的預感。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Umph...I suddenly have a feeling that's not good.
I wish to talk with the leader.
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
唔...突然有種不好的預感。
我想和隊長談談。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Something is splitting my head....Ugh....
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
頭好像要裂開了...嗚...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
....Ugh....

[Du]
Sister! Are you alright?!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
姐姐！你沒事吧？！

scripts.text:
[Verity]
....Have to go back....
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
...必須回去...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Verity, are you alright?
Can you walk?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
薇麗蒂，你沒事吧？
你能走路嗎？

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
嗚...

scripts.text:
[Du]
{0}! I think it is better that you go back.
scripts.translation:
[杜]
{0}！我覺得你最好先回去。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
N...no. I will catch up soon so go on ahead.
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
不...不用，我馬上跟上，你們先走。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Then I will stay with Verity until she recovers so you can go on ahead.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我留下照顧薇麗蒂，等她恢復。
你們先走吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Huff huff... Verity suddenly huff huff couldn't even stand straight before huff huff...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
呼，呼...薇麗蒂剛才突然...呼，呼...連站都站不穩了...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I don't think this is a problem we can solve by talking amongst ourselves.
Let's ask the leader's opinion first.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我覺得這不是我們私下商量就能解決的問題。
先去問問隊長的意見吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Ran off so fast huff...huff... to even catch up. Huff huff
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
跑得太快了，呼...呼...追都追不上...呼，呼...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Uh... Could Verity have gone that far?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
呃...薇麗蒂真的能跑那麼遠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
We need to find Verity quickly
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我們需要儘快找到薇麗蒂。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
There is only the route going up so go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
只有往上走的路，你先去吧。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Ah...Where am I..
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
啊...我在哪裡...
發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Verity]
My head...is splitting.
A sound coming from this...door...
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
頭...要裂開了。
這扇門...裡面有聲音...

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Go inside.
scripts.translation: 進去看看

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Go back...we have to go back...
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
回去...我們必須回去...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Quickly...we have to go back...
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
快...我們必須回去...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Finally.. We came back...
Finally.....
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
終於...我們回來了...
終於...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Who am I?
Who am I...
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
我是誰？
我是誰...
